verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a first-party developer path for building custom 'pieces' (connectors) in TypeScript, including a dev loop where changes appear in the browser within about 7 seconds. That covers the core of the story. An early launch-era community report said dev setup instructions were missing, which lowers confidence, but it predates the current piece-building docs and does not concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a pieces CLI or scaffolding tooling, documentation of private/self-hosted custom piece publishing, and independent hands-on corroboration of building a custom connector.
